### **System Architecture & Tooling Specification**

#### **1\. Frontend Client (Mobile App)**

| Tool / Library | Architectural Purpose | Technical Implementation |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **React Native** | Cross-platform UI rendering | Executes JavaScript thread to bridge native iOS/Android UI components. Consumes middleware JSON to render the presentation layer. |
| **Expo (EAS)** | Toolchain & Native Module Management | Orchestrates development builds, manages native dependencies without exposing iOS/Android directories, and handles Over-The-Air (OTA) updates. |
| **AsyncStorage** | Local Persistence (Bookmarks) | Stores lightweight key-value pairs (e.g., `article_id: [102, 405]`) locally on the device for the MVP offline bookmarking requirement. |
| **React Native WebView** | External Content Integration | Renders the existing web-based biweekly crossword directly within a native application view, isolating game logic from app logic. |

#### **2\. Middleware (Application Server)**

| Tool / Library | Architectural Purpose | Technical Implementation |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Node.js \+ Express** | API Gateway & Data Transformation | Acts as the intermediary layer. Intercepts mobile client requests, strips redundant web metadata, and returns optimized JSON. |
| **Expo Notifications** | Notification service | Registers device push tokens on app launch and exposes them to the backend. The Expo Push Service abstracts over APNs and FCM, allowing the Node.js server to send a single API request to Expo Push, rather than managing platform-specific integrations directly. |
| **Firebase Admin SDK\*** | Authentication | Secures the backend for user accounts (OAuth/JWT) and  |

#### **3\. Database & Infrastructure**

| Tool / Service | Architectural Purpose | Technical Implementation |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **WordPress CMS \+ MySQL** | Primary Content Store | Acts as the single source of truth for all journalistic content. Remains untouched by mobile devs to preserve the editorial team's workflow. Queries the WordPress API to access the Retrograde Content. |
| **VPS** | Middleware Hosting | Deploys the Node.js/Express server on VPS to host it. |
| **Cloudflare CDN\*** | Media Delivery | Caches and serves high-resolution article thumbnails and assets to reduce latency and offload bandwidth from the primary WordPress VPS. |
| **Analytics Software** | Telemetry (Stretch Goal) | Tracks event payloads (e.g., `screen_view`, `article_shared`) triggered by the React Native client to measure the targeted 10% readership increase. |
